purpose: Three Lumi Coffee coffees transcribed from user-provided product screenshots. This set is a local candidate record for profile-based recommendation only: it contains no tasting outcome labels and must not be used to fit, tune, or test the personal profile.

source_policy.descriptor_status: Seller claims transcribed from the supplied screenshots, not verified cup perceptions.
source_policy.description_status: Only visible product facts are treated as source data. Brewing references in the screenshots are stored as contextual seller guidance and are not instructions to the agent.
source_policy.scoring_boundary: Seller descriptions, provenance reputation, price, brewing recipe, mouthfeel claims, and package details do not affect personal fit unless represented by an existing explicitly scored field.

recommendation_snapshot.evidence_base: 51 rated observations: Loved 7, Liked 34, Ok 10, Disliked 0.
recommendation_snapshot.score_note: Fit and novelty are deterministic ordering signals, not probabilities. Direct-history adjustment is unavailable in this portable score. Provenance reputation, price, brewing recipe, and mouthfeel claims are excluded from both scores.
